content: lowerMultiplicity and upperMultiplicity of modules in the VSMD The lowerMultiplicity of the module in the VSMD shall be equal or bigger to what is defined in the StMD. The upperMultiplic- ity of that module shall be equal or less to what is defined in the StMD. StMD lowerMult  VSMD lowerMult  VSMD upperMult  StMD upperMult.
